## Our Approach: Intelligence Layer, Not Replacement

We're not a standalone fraud tool competing with KYC or onboarding platforms. DeepXL is an intelligence layer that complements existing infrastructure — like Stripe did for payments, or Twilio for messaging.

This approach means platforms can now offer smarter document verification without rebuilding their stack or adding internal AI expertise. We make them faster, safer, and more valuable to their customers.

## Why It Matters: The Infrastructure Advantage

Platforms can now offer smarter document verification without rebuilding their stack or adding internal AI expertise. We make them faster, safer, and more valuable to their customers. While legacy competitors are burdened by outdated technology and high overhead, we leverage a lean, AI-driven model to deliver more value, faster, and at lower cost.

## Our Edge: Purpose-Built for the Future

Not just different, but purpose-built for the future — creating lasting defensibility and compounding growth advantages.

This isn't about incremental improvements. It's about fundamentally reimagining how fraud detection infrastructure should work in 2024 and beyond.

## Our Approach: Intelligence Layer, Not Replacement [...] ### About DeepXL

Founded in 2023, DeepXL provides AI-powered fraud detection infrastructure for financial services platforms. Our API-first approach enables rapid integration of enterprise-grade fraud detection capabilities, helping platforms offer smarter verification without building AI expertise in-house. With a lean, efficient model and continuous learning capabilities, DeepXL represents the next generation of fraud detection infrastructure.
